<script>
    // The script leaves the referral in window.endorsely_referral, and the checkout that has to
    // carry it to Stripe is started on the server. Copied into the form when it is submitted, not
    // when the page is drawn: the HTML may be a Cloudflare copy made for somebody else, and the
    // async script may not have run yet by the time the page is ready.
    document.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
        var field = e.target && e.target.elements ? e.target.elements.endorsely_referral : null;
        if(field && window.endorsely_referral){ field.value = window.endorsely_referral; }
    }, true);
</script>
